detail.body:
## Purpose

MoRIIO KV cache registration under HMA requires a uniform `block_len` across attention layers. Hybrid models (GLM-5.2 DSA, MiniMax, Gemma4) register layers with different per-layer `block_len` / `block_size` (e.g. `9216` vs page default `2112`). Registration then raises:

```
ValueError: MoRIIO KV cache block length mismatch for layer ...: 9216 != 2112
```

and PD bring-up fails at health-gate. Layer transfers already size RDMA from per-layer geometry; the uniform check is stricter than the transfer path.

## Changes

`vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/moriio/moriio_connector.py` (KV registration):

- Allow divergent per-layer `block_len` (bytes) always; log at debug per layer; advertise `max(block_lens)` to the peer with a single summary `logger.info`.
- Allow divergent `block_size` (tokens/page) **only when hybrid KV cache manager (HMA) is enabled** (Gemma4 SWA/full-attn from #53721). Without HMA, still raise on any `block_size` mismatch (including when `block_len` also differs — ChuanLi's case).
- Per-layer spam logs moved to `logger.debug` (okorzh).

`tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py`:

- divergent `block_len` allowed
- divergent `block_size` rejected without HMA
- size+len both differ still rejected without HMA
- divergent `block_size` allowed with HMA (Gemma4)

## Test Plan

### Unit

```bash
pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py -k 'register_kv_caches_allows_hybrid or register_kv_caches_rejects_divergent or register_kv_caches_allows_hma' -q
```

### GLM-5.2-FP8 — 1P1D WideEP EP8

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=0
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM=false
export VLLM_MORIIO_DEFERRED_TIMEOUT_S=600
```

```bash
# PREFILL (node0, DP ranks 0–7) — WRITE producer
vllm serve /data/models2/GLM-5.2-FP8 \
    --host $PREFILL_IP --port 20005 -tp 1 \
    --data-parallel-size 8 \
    --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
    --data-parallel-address $PREFILL_IP \
    --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput \
    --api-server-count=8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
    --enforce-eager \
    --max-model-len 32768 \
    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_port":"9711",
      "kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"'$PREFILL_IP'","proxy_port":"10001",
      "proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","handshake_port":"6301","notify_port":"61005",
      "transfer_timeout":300,"defer_timeout":600,
      "remote_hosts":["'$DECODE_IP'"],
      "local_hosts":["'$PREFILL_IP'"],
      "remote_dp_size_local":"8"}}'
```

```bash
# DECODE (node1, DP ranks 0–7) — WRITE consumer
vllm serve /data/models2/GLM-5.2-FP8 \
    --host $DECODE_IP --port 20005 -tp 1 \
    --data-parallel-size 8 \
    --data-parallel-size-local 8 \
    --data-parallel-address $DECODE_IP \
    --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --all2all-backend mori_low_latency \
    --api-server-count=8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE"}' \
    --max-model-len 32768 \
    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MoRIIOConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_port":"9711",
      "kv_connector_extra_config":{"proxy_ip":"'$PREFILL_IP'","proxy_port":"10001",
      "proxy_ping_port":"36367","http_port":"20005","handshake_port":"7301","notify_port":"62005",
      "transfer_timeout":300,"defer_timeout":600,
      "remote_hosts":["'$PREFILL_IP'"],
      "local_hosts":["'$DECODE_IP'"],
      "remote_dp_size_local":"8"}}'
```

Bring up toy proxy (or `vllm-router`) on `$PREFILL_IP:10001` with MoRIIO WRITE discovery, then:

```bash
# health-gate must pass (no 9216 != 2112)
lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=/data/models2/GLM-5.2-FP8,base_url=http://$PREFILL_IP:10001/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64 \
  --tasks gsm8k --limit 50
```

## Test Result

GLM-5.2-FP8, MoRIIO 1P1D WideEP EP8/DP8 (proxy). GSM8K flexible-extract, threshold 0.90.

| Variant | Health | GSM8K exact_match |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stock nightly (HMA `block_len` 9216 != 2112) | Fail (`ValueError` at KV registration) | — |
| This fix | Pass | **0.94** (PASS) |

+        "layer1": torch.zeros(2, 4, 16, 1, 8, dtype=torch.float16),
+    }

+                )
+            if geometry.block_len != self.block_len:
+                logger.debug(
+                    "MoRIIO HMA per-layer block_len for %s: %d "
+                    "(page/default %d); continuing with per-layer sizes.",
+                    layer_name,
+                    geometry.block_len,
+                    self.block_len,
                 )
